'''Link-steel''' was a type of material used in building. It was noted for being lightweight.

==History==
[[Hydrospeare Corporation]]'s [[Design Team Beta]] used this material to construct the [[Explorer Submergible]] Aquatic Assault Vehicle (AAV) for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
